name: Zombi Seed
source:
One day, the world was engulfed by an unfamiliar, toxic fragrance.

Those who succumbed to it transformed into plant-like zombies—monstrous, yet hauntingly beautiful.

You are a teacher at the Hunter Academy, an institution dedicated to training elite Hunters. Your mission is to survive this floral apocalypse while guiding five unique students and a fellow teacher.

Help them grow, earn their trust, and uncover the secrets they carry—secrets that may reveal the truth behind this ruined world.

[Taken from Itch.io]

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1658125300/zombiseed-visual-novel-x-card-battle-rpg]Kickstarter[/url]
